user.title: Connect to Dockhand
user.description: Enter the address of your Dockhand instance. Create an API token in Dockhand (profile → API tokens); leave empty only if authentication is disabled.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The API token is no longer valid. Enter a new one.

abort.already_configured: This Dockhand instance is already configured.

init.title: Auto-update schedule
init.description: Non-excluded containers with an available update are updated at the chosen time on the chosen days. The next step lets you pick excluded containers.

data_description.environments: Leave empty to monitor all environments.
data_description.only_when_home: If nobody is home at the scheduled time, the update runs when a selected person arrives (same day).
data_description.persons: Update runs only if at least one of them is home.
data_description.check_before_update: Ask Dockhand to run a fresh image check right before the update.

containers.title: Excluded containers
containers.description: Selected containers are never updated automatically. They get a manual “Update” button instead.

data_description.excluded: Entries marked ⚠ are not currently reported by Dockhand.
